entities.summary: Eugeniusz Horbaczewski, also known as "Dziubek", was a Polish fighter pilot and flying ace of the Second World War. According to official lists, Horbaczewski was the third highest scoring Polish fighter ace, with 16.5 confirmed aerial victories and one probable. He was the Virtuti Militari IV class and V class, four times the Cross of Valour, and the British Distinguished Service Order and Distinguished Flying Cross (twice).
